source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with distant tan mountains and mist above a valley, temple roofs among pines, a garden pavilion compound, rocky/tree clusters, water surfaces, paths, fences, and small figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif selection.

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper mountain range: the central ochre peak and adjoining ridges, faint blue-gray left peaks, and surrounding pale mist bands. Exclude all calligraphy and red seals above it.
must_preserve: soft tan and ochre washes on the main peak
faint contour lines defining ridges
irregular white mist gaps and cloud-like edges crossing the mountain
subtle blue-gray silhouettes of receding peaks at left
dry-brush texture and pale erosion-like streaks on the slopes

motifs.name: left_waterfall_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle cliff mass with rounded ochre rocks, the narrow white waterfall dropping through the ravine, and the pale water pool at its base. Avoid neighboring pavilion roofs and distant temple elements.
must_preserve: thin white vertical waterfall channel
rounded layered rock contours in light brown and green washes
small dark cave-like opening near the pool
soft misty water edge at the base
fine reddish-brown contour strokes on the cliff faces

motifs.name: pine_temple_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the temple and pagoda group set into the right hillside, including the stepped red-roofed pagoda, partial hall roofs, and the vertical pine avenue rising along the slope. Exclude the nearby red seal on the hill.
must_preserve: stacked pagoda roof geometry with red accents
glimpsed red and gray tiled roofs behind trees
slender dark pine trunks arranged in a diagonal line
needle-like pine foliage strokes
green hillside wash and fine slope contouring

motifs.name: central_garden_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the main garden architecture in the middle: connected white-walled pavilions with gray tiled roofs, open veranda, interior furnishings and tiny figures, plus the immediate courtyard edge. Do not include the large right scholar rock cluster except where it touches the architecture.
must_preserve: precise roof tile striping and roof angles
white wall planes with thin ink outlines
open colonnade and veranda posts
tiny interior figures and red furniture accents
surrounding garden shrubs and pale wash transitions around the buildings

motifs.name: right_scholar_rock_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side garden rock and tree cluster beside the pavilion: perforated gray scholar rock, tall dark pines, pale blue-green foliage, and adjacent shrubs. Avoid the pavilion interior as much as possible.
must_preserve: hollow openings and angular contours of the scholar rock
dark gray ink washes on rock faces
tall pine trunks with dense vertical needle texture
blue-green clustered foliage around the rock
fine grasses and shrubs at the base

motifs.name: middle_water_garden
motifs.description: Isolate the broad pale water surface and garden shore below the pavilion, including the irregular banks, small birds on or above the water, reflections/wash texture, and the lone white-robed figure on the right bank.
must_preserve: flat pale water wash with subtle horizontal texture
irregular tan shoreline and low fence lines
small dark birds rendered with minimal strokes
white-robed standing figure on the bank
soft transition between water, mud banks, and sparse vegetation

motifs.name: left_rocky_bank_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the left rocky bank beside the water, including stacked ochre rocks, gnarled trees, the small arched crossing/bridge-like path, and tiny animals or figures visible among the rocks. Keep it separate from the central pavilion roofs.
must_preserve: layered ochre and gray rock texture
gnarled tree trunks and bare branch linework
small arched crossing or path detail
tiny living figures/animals indicated by fine strokes
dark-to-light wash variation in the crevices

motifs.name: bottom_gate_fence_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the lower garden entrance area: the small open gate pavilion, diagonal fence or wall, foreground pines and bare trees, and low shrubs along the bottom edge. Exclude the red seal at the lower left border.
must_preserve: small roofed gate with open doorway and tiled roof lines
diagonal lattice fence/wall pattern
slender pine trunks with dark needle clusters
bare winter-branch linework
low green shrubs and pale ground wash around the entrance

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
